# rail Provider

Declaratively provision Link Resilience Units on a [RAIL](https://github.com/HelgeSverre/rail-rs) (Redundant Array of Inexpensive Links) deployment. Infrastructure as Code, for URLs, for redundancy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rail = {
      source = "helgesverre/rail"
    }
  }
}

# The top of the pyramid. Also settable as RAIL_ENDPOINT.
provider "rail" {
  endpoint = "http://edge.rail.localhost:8080"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the RAIL tier to provision against, usually the top of the pyramid. Falls back to the `RAIL_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
